title: geracium molle
intro: Geracium molle, commonly known as Soft Geranium, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Geraniaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Geracium molle include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Geracium molle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
